subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Soak Testing
description: A fast breakdown of Soak Testing for builders.

hook.text: A system runs perfectly for one hour. After 72 hours under load, memory usage hits 100% and it freezes.

buildup.text: Some bugs only appear over time: memory leaks, connection pool exhaustion, and log file bloat.

discovery.text: Soak testing runs the system under sustained load for hours or days to find time-dependent problems.

twist.text: Short load tests miss these entirely. The system looks healthy for minutes but degrades over hours.

climax.text: A 48-hour soak test reveals a memory leak growing 50MB per hour. Fixed before production suffers.

punchline.text: Soak testing finds the bugs that only appear with patience.

quiz.question: What kind of bugs does soak testing find?
